question: Should the dashboard agent-status widget ship now as a sessions.list-backed builtin in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/101826, or should this issue wait for the broader sessions.activity Gateway contract?
rationale: The user value is clear, but choosing the durable source of truth for current task, progress, attention, and cross-agent activity is a product/API decision that read-only cleanup cannot settle.

options.title: Keep the staged dashboard builtin
options.body: Treat the open pull request as the implementation candidate while requiring its review blockers, real browser proof, and stack conflicts to clear before this issue closes.

options.title: Wait for the activity contract
options.body: Keep this issue open until the broader sessions.activity Gateway contract lands, then implement the widget against that richer API.

options.title: Fold into the roadmap tracker
options.body: Make https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/101136 own sequencing only if this issue's concrete status-widget requirements are preserved there.

recommendation.title: Keep the staged dashboard builtin
recommendation.body: Treat the open pull request as the implementation candidate while requiring its review blockers, real browser proof, and stack conflicts to clear before this issue closes.

likelyOwner.reason: Current-main blame places the closest UI/plugin-tab and sessions.list integration points on Vincent Koc's recent commit, making him the best available routing owner for the product/API boundary question.
